description: This file defines a PHP class 'BCMDataExportsClient' which extends the 'AwsClient' class. It provides method annotations for interacting with the AWS Billing and Cost Management Data Exports service, including operations like creating, deleting, retrieving, listing, and updating exports. The class is part of the 'Aws\BCMDataExports' namespace and serves as a client wrapper for the corresponding AWS service API.

classes.name: BCMDataExportsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Billing and Cost Management Data Exports service, providing methods for managing exports and associated resources.

methods.name: createExport
methods.description: Creates a new data export in AWS Billing and Cost Management service.

methods.name: createExportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new data export, returning a Promise.

methods.name: deleteExport
methods.description: Deletes an existing data export.

methods.name: deleteExportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an existing data export.

methods.name: getExecution
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific export execution.

methods.name: getExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specific export execution.

methods.name: getExport
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific export.

methods.name: getExportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specific export.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Gets information about a specific data table in the export.

methods.name: getTableAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets information about a specific data table.

methods.name: listExecutions
methods.description: Lists all executions associated with exports.

methods.name: listExecutionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all executions.

methods.name: listExports
methods.description: Lists all data exports.

methods.name: listExportsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all data exports.

methods.name: listTables
methods.description: Lists all tables available in the export service.

methods.name: listTablesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all tables.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a given AWS resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags an AWS resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously tags an AWS resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from an AWS resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateExport
methods.description: Updates an existing data export.

methods.name: updateExportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a data export.
